identity: A figure or group of items appears with a question, and the user answers by clicking an item or choice, selecting several items, or typing a number.

scenarios.name: color
scenarios.screen: A palette of about six swatches is visible. The question names a color or shows a sample swatch to match; no answer is selected.
never: An open color picker
A swatch already marked as the answer
Thirteen swatches

arrangements.text: The swatches sit in a row across the task area.
A sample swatch sits above a grid of answer swatches.
arrangements.traits: sample mode; site skin: stacked palette

scenarios.hint: Show requested target color as one of several flat color boxes; when matching sample, include a distinct sample and exactly one match. No texture or lighting on task colors.

scenarios.name: shades
scenarios.screen: A grid of about twelve colored tiles contains shades from several hue families. Every tile starts unselected.
never: A tile already selected
A separate color picker
A sample image beside the grid

arrangements.text: The tile grid sits in the middle of the task area.
The tile grid sits toward the left side of the task area.

scenarios.hint: Show a tile grid with several true shades of requested color and clearly different hues; no decorative colored tiles outside the scored grid.

scenarios.name: shape
scenarios.screen: A board contains letters, digits, or shapes in separate cells. No item has a selection ring.
never: An item already ringed as the answer
A separate answer list
Items placed outside the board cells

arrangements.text: The cell board sits in the middle of the task area.
The cell board sits toward the left side of the task area.

scenarios.hint: Show a set of easily distinguished geometric shapes/letters, correct requested color and size with one unambiguous target; large purple T must really be a T.

scenarios.name: identify
scenarios.screen: One large figure appears with several answer buttons that describe possible figures. No button is selected.
never: A second figure to identify
An answer button already selected
A text field for the answer

arrangements.text: The figure sits above a row of answer buttons.
The figure sits to the left of a vertical list of answer buttons.

scenarios.hint: Show one unambiguous geometric figure in a frame and answer buttons including its correct name, with plausible distractors; no answer highlighted.

scenarios.name: count
scenarios.screen: The task area shows either a board of shapes to count or one polygon whose sides must be counted. Number buttons or an empty number field sit by the figure.
never: A count already entered or chosen
Both number buttons and a number field for the same answer
A second polygon in the sides task

arrangements.text: The figure sits above the number answer controls.
The figure sits to the left of the number answer controls.

scenarios.hint: No decorative shapes that could count.

scenarios.name: greatest
scenarios.screen: About four numbered cards sit together. In the face-down task their values are covered at the start; in the open task all values are visible.
never: A face-up card in the face-down task's initial state
Two face-up cards at once in the face-down task
A separate number entry field

arrangements.text: The cards sit in a row across the task area.
The cards sit in a compact grid in the task area.

scenarios.hint: Show cards bearing different signed or unsigned numbers with one unique greatest value; no card selected.

scenarios.name: grid
scenarios.screen: A labeled coordinate plane shows dots at its grid points. None of the dots is selected.
never: A dot already selected
A movable point outside the plane
A text field for coordinates

arrangements.text: The coordinate plane sits in the middle of the task area.
The coordinate plane sits toward the left side of the task area.

scenarios.hint: Show a Cartesian grid with correctly numbered axes, origin and negative coordinates; requested coordinate is available, not already marked.

scenarios.name: addition
scenarios.screen: Two groups of blocks are visible beside an empty number field for their total.
never: A total already typed
A third block group
Number buttons in place of the text field

arrangements.text: The two block groups sit side by side above the number field.
The two block groups sit one above the other, with the number field below them.

scenarios.hint: Show two small distinct groups of identical blocks with a plus symbol between them and an empty total textbox. All blocks countable, no occlusion.

scenarios.name: ascending
scenarios.screen: Several numbered tiles occupy positions in a board. All numbers are visible, and no tile has been clicked.
never: A number hidden before the first click
A tile already recorded in the sequence
A separate list of sorted numbers

arrangements.text: The numbered board sits in the middle of the task area.
The numbered board sits toward the left side of the task area.

scenarios.hint: Show scattered distinct number buttons in a scrambled arrangement, all unclicked. No duplicate values.

scenarios.name: number-checkboxes
scenarios.screen: An example digit or pattern appears beside a grid of checkboxes to copy it into. The answer grid starts unchecked.
never: A box in the answer grid already checked
A typed digit field
A second answer grid

arrangements.text: The example sits to the left of the checkbox grid.
The example sits above the checkbox grid.

scenarios.hint: Show a small filled-cell reference digit exactly matching requested number and an adjacent same-sized blank checkbox grid; every reference cell aligns to a target checkbox.

scenarios.name: spatial
scenarios.screen: A board holds glyphs or icons in rows and columns. The question identifies an item by its position relative to another item or by its place in a row or column; nothing is selected.
never: An item already ringed as the answer
A separate map of arrows between items
Items outside the board

arrangements.text: The item board sits in the middle of the task area.
The item board sits toward the left side of the task area.

scenarios.name: icon
scenarios.screen: A board contains several clickable icons, some with different colors or repeated kinds. No icon is selected.
never: An icon already marked as the answer
An open icon menu
A separate text field for the icon name

arrangements.text: The icon board sits in the middle of the task area.
The icon board sits toward the left side of the task area.

scenarios.name: scroll-count
scenarios.screen: A scrollable list pane shows the first few rows of a longer list, with an icon and label in each row. Number buttons or an empty number field provide the answer; no answer is chosen.
never: The list already scrolled halfway down
A number already chosen or typed
Both number buttons and a number field for the same answer

arrangements.text: The list pane sits above the number answer controls.
The list pane sits to the left of the number answer controls.
